programme.title: Singh is King
programme.desc: Directed by Anees Bazmee, this action-comedy features Akshay Kumar as Happy Singh, whose journey from a village in Punjab to becoming a crime lord in Australia is filled with humor, action, and unexpected turns.

programme.title: Double Dhamaal
programme.desc: Directed by Indra Kumar, this follow-up to Dhamaal reunites the original gang Ritesh Deshmukh, Arshad Warsi, Aashish Chaudhary, and Javed Jaffrey as they attempt to double-cross a slick businessman (Sanjay Dutt). With new additions Kangana Ranaut and Mallika Sherawat, the film delivers over-the-top antics and comedic twists.

programme.title: Kalyug
programme.desc: Directed by Mohit Suri, Kalyug stars Kunal Khemu in his debut adult role. The film follows his character's descent into the pornographic underworld after a personal tragedy. As he seeks revenge, he uncovers the industry's seedy operations, leading to a gripping narrative about morality and redemption.

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: Devki, a biology teacher, seeks help from DK, a private detective, and vows to get revenge after her stepdaughter's rapists are acquitted by the court.

programme.title: Simmba
programme.desc: Simmba follows the story of Sangram "Simmba" Bhalerao, a corrupt and flamboyant police officer who enjoys the perks of his position until a personal tragedy forces him to rethink his choices. Transforming into a man of justice, Simmba takes on a powerful criminal nexus. With high-octane action, emotional drama, and punchy dialogues, this Rohit Shetty directorial stars Ranveer Singh and Sara Ali Khan in a thrilling narrative of redemption.
